newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Popular Holdings offers 75 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Popular Holdings offers 75 mln shares.

text.p: Popular Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was offering 75 million new shares at Singapore 36 cents each in its initial public offering.
A company statement said the offer comprised a public tranche of 63.75 million shares and a placement tranche of 11.25 million shares.
At S$0.36, the shares represent a forecast price earnings ratio of 11.9 times.

Popular was founded in 1924 as an importer and distributor of Chinese books and magazines. Today the group is engaged in publishing, distribution of office products, bookstore operations and franchising.
For its 1997 financial year, the group has forecast that turnover will reach $165.9 million and after tax profits will reach $6.8 million.
Net proceeds of about S$25.3 million from the IPO will be used to finance a warehouse-cum-office, open new bookstores, repay bank borrowings and be used as working capital.
The offer will close on May 7 and trading is expected to begin on May 9.
